formula.name: Osmanthus Sandalwood Crème — 30mL EdP
formula.body:
# Osmanthus Sandalwood Crème — 30mL EdP

## Character
Osmanthus apricot-tea floating on a bed of creamy sandalwood. The peach-apricot fruit opens over warm, milky-soft Ebanol and fresh Sandalore. No citrus competition, no leather-darkness, no oakmoss bitterness. Clean, modern, universally pleasant. Think osmanthus meeting Santal 33 in a By Kilian bottle.

**Family**: Woody Floral (modern niche) — sandalwood-anchored, osmanthus-centered
**Materials**: 18
**Concentration**: 16% EdP

## Headspace (Composite OAV Model)

| Voice | OAV | Role |
|-------|--:|------|
| Osmanthus Absolute | ~1,500 | The star — apricot-tea character |
| Hedione HC | ~5,000 | Abstract radiance |
| Iso E Super | ~2,500 | Skin cocoon |
| Ebanol | ~300 | Creamy sandalwood — warm, milky, yielding |
| Sandalore | ~200 | Fresh sandalwood — airy, citrus-woody |
| Bergamot FCF | ~150 | Opening whisper |

## Formula

| # | Ingredient | Dilution | Amount (µL) | Amount (mL) |
|---|-----------|----------|-------------|-------------|
| **🌅 Top** |
| 1 | Bergamot FCF | neat | 80 | 0.080 |
| 2 | Linalool | neat | 40 | 0.040 |
| **💕 Heart** |
| 3 | Osmanthus Absolute | 10% in DPG | 700 | 0.700 |
| 4 | Rose de Mai Absolute | 10% in DPG | 120 | 0.120 |
| 5 | Hedione HC | neat | 1000 | 1.000 |
| 6 | Apritone | 10% | 100 | 0.100 |
| 7 | Gamma Decalactone | neat | 80 | 0.080 |
| 8 | Beta Ionone | 1% in TEC | 120 | 0.120 |
| 9 | Alpha Ionone | neat | 60 | 0.060 |
| 10 | Guaiacol | 10% | 15 | 0.015 |
| **🪵 Base** |
| 11 | Ebanol | neat | 80 | 0.080 |
| 12 | Sandalore | neat | 80 | 0.080 |
| 13 | Iso E Super | neat | 400 | 0.400 |
| 14 | Ethylene Brassylate | neat | 200 | 0.200 |
| 15 | Romandolide | neat | 220 | 0.220 |
| 16 | Zenolide | neat | 120 | 0.120 |
| 17 | Ambrettolide | 10% in DPG | 60 | 0.060 |
| 18 | Vertofix | neat | 80 | 0.080 |
| 19 | Cedramber | neat | 60 | 0.060 |
| 20 | Ambrofix | 30% w/v | 50 | 0.050 |

**Concentrate total**: 4,685 µL (15.6% of 30mL EdP)
**Materials**: 20

## Creamy Sandalwood Chord

| Material | Dose | Character |
|----------|------|-----------|
| Ebanol | 60 neat | Milky-soft, yielding — the "cream" in creamy sandalwood |
| Sandalore | 80 neat | Fresh, citrus-woody — the "lift" that prevents heaviness |
| Ethylene Brassylate | 200 neat | Lactonic musk — doubles the creaminess. Pairs with osmanthus lactones |
| Romandolide | 200 neat | Diffusive projection — spreads the sandalwood outward |

## Why This Should Outscore the Chypre

| Score | Chypre Ceiling | Wood Floral Target | Why |
|-------|:---:|:---:|------|
| Hedonic | 83.9 | **90+** | Creamy sandalwood + peach = universally pleasant. No leather/oakmoss |
| Mass Appeal | 3.3 | **6+** | "What are you wearing?" vs "That's interesting." Woody-floral sells |
| Sophistication | 3.0 | **5+** | Sandalwood reads as luxury. Chypre reads as "old lady" to untrained noses |
| Elegance | 3.5 | **6+** | 18 materials, clean architecture, visible chord structure |
| Longevity | 82 | **80+** | Ebanol + sandalwood + ethylene brassylate base — 6-8h |
| Sillage | 102 | **100+** | Romandolide 200 + Iso E 400 — strong projection through musk |

## What Was Deliberately Excluded

| Not Used | Why |
|----------|-----|
| Oakmoss Absolute, Patchouli, Evernyl, IBQ, Suederal, Labdanum | No chypre skeleton — this is WOODY floral, not chypre |
| Damascone Beta | Osmanthus + Apritone + Gamma Decalactone already cover apricot. Adding damascone = overdetermined |
| Benzyl Salicylate | Too heavy, cosmetic. Breaks the clean sandalwood transparency |
| Cedarwood EO | Too dry-pencil for creamy sandalwood. Ebanol + Sandalore alone |
